interpreted_request.runtime: under two and a half hours

movies.title: Gone Girl
movies.reason: A marriage unravels into a media circus, exactly the cold, controlled tension you asked for.

movies.title: Nightcrawler
movies.reason: Los Angeles at night, a camera, and a man with no brakes. Relentlessly uncomfortable.

movies.title: The Prestige
movies.reason: Two magicians ruin each other over one trick. Structured like a puzzle box, pays off twice.

movies.title: The Menu
movies.reason: A tasting menu that turns into a trap. Sharper and funnier than the rest of this list.

movies.title: Zodiac
movies.reason: An obsession procedural about a case nobody closes. Patient, detailed, quietly devastating.

movies.title: Nocturnal Animals
movies.reason: A novel inside a marriage inside a revenge story. Cold, stylish, and genuinely cruel.

movies.title: The Game
movies.reason: A birthday gift becomes a conspiracy you cannot opt out of. Paranoia played straight.

movies.title: The Gentlemen
movies.reason: A drug empire changes hands through blackmail and bad manners. Fast, funny, and very pleased with itself.
